rows.text: Monetary Policy Committee's Decision on 1 December 2010
announces the outcome of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting today, as
The global economy continues to recover as expected.
Inflationary pressure, while stable at present, is expected to rise in line with
result, pressure on core inflation, going forward, is expected to rise.
In light of these developments, the MPC saw a lesser need to maintain the
policy interest rate by 0.25 per cent per annum, from 1.75 to 2.00 per cent per annum,
